Its a bestseller for a reason. Weightless, easy to blend, long-lasting... It's pinch-perfect color. 💖

At Rare Beauty, we’re always rethinking design to make beauty more accessible. Traditional perfume bottles can be challenging for those with dexterity limitations. We partnered with Casa Colina Research Institute, certified hand therapists, and packaging engineers to create a luxe, ergonomic design for effortless, comfortable spraying.

In a study of 56 individuals with upper extremity impairments:
- 96% said the oversized pump is easier to press
- 95% said the bottle shape gives a more secure grip
- 90% said the pump design makes spraying easier

Shop Rare Eau de Parfum only @sephora, @sephoracanada, Sephora @kohls, and rarebeauty.com
